about: The introitus of the formulary “Fifth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Declare a voice of joy, and let it be heard, alleluia; declare it to the end of the earth: the Lord has delivered His people, alleluia, alleluia. Shout with joy to God, all the earth; sing a psalm to His name; give glory to His praise. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
